data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 53.5m (3.23% of opening gross claims outstanding) in 2015. This release was driven by favourable claims development reflecting a benign catastrophe year, a lower volume of large losses and increased prior period reserve releases (notably on North America catastrophe and special risk classes). The managing agent also reports specific 2015 losses (winter freeze and the Tianjin explosion) but overall prior-year re-estimation produced a net release.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement sourced from note 9(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column) which shows (53.5) i.e. a GBP 53.5m gross release. The Managing Agent narrative reports releases of GBP 38.3m (this is net/other presentation) - the gross movement used here is from the technical reserves reconciliation. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 29) and was cross-checked; triangle parsing is partial because the PDF table is triangular and some cells are not applicable for recent underwriting years. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (GBP).
